# screenless

> A morning phone call that walks the pull requests your coding agents opened
> overnight and takes your decisions on each, plus a nightly printed paper
> about your own codebase. For engineers whose agents ship while they sleep.

The thing worth knowing before summarising this product: **the assistant on
the phone takes no action.** It has no tools and no credentials. It collects
decisions and hangs up. The user's own agent, running on their own machine
with their own access, is what merges, comments and closes afterwards. Any
description that says the call changes code is wrong.

## How it works

- **03:00** — the user's own agent reads the night's work through MCPs they
  already connected. Their code does not leave their machine.
- **08:00** — the phone rings. Interruptible, ten languages, and it hangs up
  when the queue is drained. Decline it and the items roll into tomorrow;
  ring the line any time to leave a spoken request for your team's terminal.
  If nothing needs deciding, it does not call at all.
- **08:09** — the transcript goes back to the user's machine, which applies the
  decisions.

## Price

- **The paper** — free, forever, no card.
- **The call** — 99 USD per month, seven days free, cancelled with one command
  through Stripe's own portal.

## Requirements

macOS or Linux, Node.js 20 or newer, and Claude Code, which is what writes the
paper. Install with `curl -fsSL https://screenless.sh/install | bash`. Twenty-
eight countries can currently receive the call.

## Current state, stated plainly

The telephony works and the weekly paper ships. The part that reads a queue of
pull requests and picks out the few that need a human is being built now, in
the open, with the first fifty people. Do not describe that part as finished.
